rationales: © is the symbol for copyright.
ⓔ is not the copyright symbol.
$ is the symbol for a dollar currency unit.
® is the registered trademark symbol.
.doc is commonly used for Word documents, not HTML pages.
.XLS is commonly used for spreadsheet files, not HTML pages.
.ppt is commonly used for presentation files, not HTML pages.
.html is the standard file extension for an HTML page.
DHCP does not stand for Data Hosting Computer Protocol.
DHCP does not stand for Data Host Configuration Protocol.
DHCP does not stand for Dynamic Host Computer Protocol.
DHCP stands for Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol.
Valid test data checks expected inputs, not specifically extreme values.
Invalid test data checks unacceptable inputs, not specifically extreme values.
Boundary test data checks values at the limits of the input range.
Absent data tests what happens when input is missing.
Four bytes are not required as the minimum storage unit for information.
Three bytes are not required as the minimum storage unit for information.
Two bytes are not required as the minimum storage unit for information.
A byte is the minimum unit among these choices for storing information.
A client system alone does not describe the joint operation of browsers and servers.
Web browsers act as clients and web servers provide services in a client-server system.
A server system alone does not describe the joint operation of browsers and servers.
Computer system is too general; the specific model is client-server.
A diamond does not represent input in a flowchart.
A terminal symbol represents the start or end of a flowchart.
A diamond represents a decision in a flowchart.
A diamond does not represent output in a flowchart.
Start marks the beginning of an algorithm and does not check a condition.
If-else checks a condition and selects a path based on its result.
Set assigns a value and does not typically check a condition.
Goto transfers control and does not itself check a condition.
0–10 includes 10, which is not a decimal digit.
1–10 omits 0 and includes 10, so it is incorrect.
The decimal system uses the digits 0 through 9.
1–9 omits 0, which is a decimal digit.
0 is not always the result because A may be 1.
1 is not always the result because A may be 0.
A OR False equals A by the identity property of Boolean OR.
The result is not always every listed value; it is specifically A.
Parentheses are not used to enclose HTML tags.
Square brackets are not used to enclose HTML tags.
HTML tags are enclosed in angle brackets.
Braces are not used to enclose HTML tags.
Protocols can include rules for authentication.
Protocols can include rules for error detection.
Protocols can include rules for error correction.
Protocols can cover authentication, error detection, and correction.
The receiver must be capable of accepting the message being sent.
The protocol is a set of communication rules, not what the receiver accepts.
An address identifies a destination but is not the item the receiver accepts.
Information is the meaning conveyed, while the transmitted item is called a message.
06 characters is shorter than the commonly recommended minimum of 8.
08 characters is the expected minimum password length in this question.
10 characters may be stronger, but it is not the expected answer here.
12 characters may be stronger, but it is not the expected answer here.
A password is a secret credential, not a human-verification challenge.
A signature line is a space for a signature, not a human-verification challenge.
Verification is a general process and is not the specific name for this text challenge.
CAPTCHA is a challenge used to distinguish human users from automated systems.
